_about: Sources read 2 October 2026 for World War II batch 2 of the war memorial sourcing. The Navy's California list and Oklahoma's Army Honor List downloaded from the NARA catalog (Nathan approved both) to inventory/legacy/fetched/nara-navy-ca/ and nara-honor-list-ok/ (the PDFs are not committed: 150 MB and 23 MB; re-downloadable from the catalog); entries read by eye from rendered pages. California Army Honor List lines read by eye from inventory/legacy/fetched/nara-honor-list-ca/.

navyList.source: Navy Department, State Summary of War Casualties from World War II for Navy, Marine Corps, and Coast Guard Personnel from California (1946), NARA NAID 305189, Dead section

510 Whitmore.text: WHITMORE, Frank Pike, Soundman 3c, USN. Parents, Mr. and Mrs. George Fred Whitmore, 1445 Walnut St., Newhall.

572 Cherry.text: CHERRY, Perry Leon, Seaman 2c, USN. Parents, Mr. and Mrs. Frank John Cherry, 3200 1/2 W. 109th St., Inglewood.

578 Fose.text: FOSE, Robert Remy, Seaman 2c, USNR. Wife, Mrs. Lucretia Maryan Fose, 2115 Valentine St., Los Angeles.

navyList.notFound: James Robert Ball, Lawrence E. Kenaston and Thomas Milton Ross Jr. are not in the California list, dead or missing (read by eye where they would sort); the list is filed by the next of kin's state.

abmc.564 Redmond: American Battle Monuments Commission memorial certificate, held in this archive (ww2_jamesmredmond_certificate.jpg): James M. Redmond, Staff Sergeant, U.S. Army, 299th Engineer Combat Battalion; date of death December 21, 1944; Ardennes American Cemetery, Neupré, Belgium

local.1407 Pineau: World War II draft registration card, William Ernest Pineau, registered June 30, 1942, Local Board No. 175, Palmdale (National Archives, Record Group 147), held in this archive (ww2_williamernestpineau_draft_large.jpg): place of residence Agua Dulce Canyon, Saugus, Los Angeles County; born April 30, 1924, Albuquerque, New Mexico
